summary: Pedestrian paseo on Bridgeview Street north of Exposition Street (Toni Stone Crossing), next to Block G (the Visa building) and Block K on Pier & Point's mapped geometry. The 2019 Phase 1 submittal planned it as part of Phase 1, and the Port says Phase 1 public infrastructure, including 'the paseos in the bottom around Building G leading in to China Basin Park', has been accepted.

milestones.text: Final Design Controls (document dated April 24, 2018) lists the Bridgeview Street paseo in Figure 3.1.1 as 'Section 4.4 Paseo: Bridgeview Street'
Phase 1 submittal says Phase 1 'will also complete the Shared Public Way and Bridgeview Street paseos north of Exposition Street'

Port Commission passes Resolutions 25-05 and 25-06 unanimously to accept Phase 1 public infrastructure; staff describe 'the paseos in the bottom around Building G leading in to China Basin Park' as Port owned
Port staff report says the Developer completed Phase 1 in 2025 and 'the City has accepted all public infrastructure, including parks, streets, and public utilities within the Phase'

sources.title: Mission Rock Design Controls, April 24, 2018 (final; Section 3 open spaces, Figure 3.1.1)

sources.title: Minutes of the Port Commission meeting, February 11, 2025 (Mission Rock Phase 1 acceptance; Resolutions 25-05 and 25-06)

Informational presentation on updates to the Mission Rock Development Project, including efforts to accelerate Phase 2, with possible action on a Port Capital investment of $10 million (Port Commission Item 11A, Resolution 26-34)

open_questions: No source read names this paseo on its own as built or accepted. The 'complete' status rests on the Port's general statements that Phase 1 public infrastructure, including the paseos around Building G, was accepted (Feb 2025 minutes, June 2026 report); the site was not checked against imagery or a site visit.
Acceptance date and construction cost for this paseo are not published separately in any source read.
